_schema.about: art audit 2026-10-16 batch D (structures and screens): dock clamp v2, caged beacons, station variants, hangar platform v2 + hangar bay. glTF coordinates (+X = dock / bow, +Y = up).
_schema.integration: DROP-IN = same file + node contract, rebuild shows it; SMALL CODE = path list / manifest copy
_schema.files: per file: integration, tris (shipped GLB incl. children), nodes (name -> glTF position), notes
_schema.layouts: new station layouts: art/blender/data/station_layouts_batch_d.json (merge into station_layouts.json + the src/data copy)

dock_clamp.notes: origin = dock_port, extent x -2.4..0.6, y -1.5..1.5 (Blender) unchanged; guide_light_0..3 unchanged (left+right pair, index grows along +X). New: Clamp_Jaw_L / Clamp_Jaw_R (pivot = outer hinge, closed = rest pose). Optional animation: open = rotate +35 deg (L) / -35 deg (R) about local +Y while the ship is out of range, close during the docking latch.

outpost_a.notes: caged beacon lamps: beacon_<i> = the lamp lens only (same order + colours, positions moved <= ~0.3 to sit on a surface); the cage housing is part of the static mesh. Other nodes unchanged.

hangar_platform.notes: 17 x 17, 15 x 15 floor clean, floor top z -0.37 (glTF y), all geometry below glTF y 0.5 (HangarView GANTRY_CUT 0.55 ghosts nothing now - the clipping can stay or go). Pedestal down to the bay deck (glTF y -1.90).

hangar_bay.notes: add to the hangar yard group (same frame as hangar_platform: origin = platform centre, +X = bow). Height rule: every vertex at horizontal distance r from the centre stays below glTF y = -0.37 + 0.6 (r - 8.5) (camera orbit 360, pitch >= 35, FOV 34) - verified at build. Bay door opens to space on +X (the far side at the default yaw). Optional animation: Arm_<i> slides along local X on its rail (range in railX), Arm_<i>_Head turns about local +Y; Arm_<i>_Tip = weld-spark origin.
